            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="142a3"/> mi dge' ba la skyes thob dang skyon byung 2su gzhung 'di nyid
            nas bshad pas tha bar gyi ston pa rnams la skye bas stobs pa dang phyor byung bas phyi
            ba gzhus de nyid nas bshad pas khas 2 kyi ston pa rnaMs la skyes pas thebs dang thob par
            bya ba'i chos bcu' rgyu yin no zhes ces te | ldan pa'i yi yag logs su bzang du Nado ||
            yang ma 'dis pa blo ston na de shan rang dang theg pa chen po 2 la slob pa 'gag pa dang
            mi slob pa thag pa <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="142a4"/> 2 2 du dbye'o zhes zer te | theg pa'i gnas phye zin
            kyang logs su bgrang du do ||</seg></TEI>
